shared_elements: incised/carved linear marks on a flat stone face
roughly horizontal alignment of repeated marks
justification: The only correspondence is the most generic one: both surfaces bear cut linear marks loosely aligned along a horizontal register. A depicts a fully worked-out figural programme — files of standing human figures in profile with headgear and spears, repeated leaf/plant motifs and stepped architectural framing — whereas B shows only sparse angular scratched strokes with no recognisable creature, figure or attribute, so no shared motif, relationship or drawing convention can be identified.
